resources.string: Import YAML rules
Import a Clash classical provider with a payload list. Paste YAML or an HTTPS link, or choose a local file. GitHub file links are supported. The selected destination applies to all imported rules.
YAML content or HTTPS link
Paste
Choose file
Selected file: %1$s
YAML routing rules
Processing rules…
%1$d unique entries: %2$d domains, %3$d IP ranges, %4$d ports, %5$d networks.
Existing rules are kept. Imported rules take priority over existing domain/IP rules. Reconnect to apply changes.
Preview
Import rules
Imported %1$d rule entries. Reconnect to apply.
Invalid format near line %1$d. Use payload: followed by a list of rule strings, not a complete Clash configuration. Use UTF-8 encoding.

Line %1$d (%2$s) cannot be converted. Supported: DOMAIN, DOMAIN-SUFFIX, DOMAIN-KEYWORD, DOMAIN-REGEX, IP-CIDR, IP-CIDR6, DST-PORT and NETWORK. Extra outbound columns and no-resolve are not supported. Nothing was imported.
Invalid value at line %1$d (%2$s). Check the domain, IP range, port or network.
No rule entries found.

Safety limit exceeded. Split the file or remove existing rules: up to 8 MiB, 50,000 unique rules, 16 KiB per line, 128 regex rules and 256 port rules per file. Repeated entries, normalized output and total stored rules are also bounded.
Enter an HTTPS rule link without embedded login details.
Download failed (HTTP %1$s). Check the rule link and try again.
Could not read the rules. Check the file permission or network connection, then retry.
Parsing exceeded its time budget. Split the rule file and retry.
Import cancelled.
The previous parsing task is stopping. Retry in a moment.
Paste supports up to 64K characters. Import larger rules using a file or link.
Large rule content is shown as a summary. You can edit the name and destination. To change its contents, remove this rule and import the updated file.
